units.source_text: 汉字偏旁游戏，即仅示字之偏旁，教人猜测此是何字。

en.t: The Chinese character radical game means showing only part of a character and having people guess what character it is.

units.source_text: 或示若干字之偏旁，教人补凑成字，造成一句。

en.t: Or several character parts are shown, and people are asked to fill in and combine them into characters to form a line.
